summary: Stripe payment integration for software solutions fully tested. All backend APIs (11 tests) and frontend features (7 test cases) passed. Checkout sessions, payment status, and payment success page work correctly.
passed_tests: Backend API Tests (11/11 passed):
- GET /api/payments/packages returns list of available packages
- Packages have required fields: id, name, amount, type, product_id
- Expected packages exist: survey360_monthly, survey360_annual, fieldforce_10seats, fieldforce_50seats
- Survey360 monthly price is $99
- FieldForce 10 seats price is $499 with type 'package' (one-time)
- POST /api/payments/checkout rejects invalid package_id (400)
- POST /api/payments/checkout rejects enterprise packages (400 - requires contact)
- POST /api/payments/checkout creates Stripe session for valid package (returns url + session_id)
- POST /api/payments/checkout works for FieldForce package
- GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns status for valid session
- GET /api/payments/status/{invalid_id} handles invalid session
Frontend UI Tests (7/7 passed):
- Solutions Hub Page (/solutions) loads with all software products
- Survey360 detail page (/solutions/survey360) displays pricing section with $99/month and $990/year
- FieldForce detail page (/solutions/fieldforce) displays one-time pricing ($499, $1,999, $4,999)
- Buy Now button initiates Stripe checkout (API call to /api/payments/checkout)
- Clicking Buy Now redirects to Stripe checkout.stripe.com with correct amount
- Payment Success page (/payment/success) handles missing session_id with error state
- Payment Success page shows 'Processing' then 'Payment Status Pending' for unpaid sessions
test_credentials: N/A - No authentication required for payment testing
seed_data_creation: N/A - Payment packages are defined server-side in SOFTWARE_PACKAGES
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe payment integration is fully functional using emergentintegrations library with test key sk_test_emergent. Key endpoints: POST /api/payments/checkout (creates Stripe session), GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} (checks payment status), GET /api/payments/packages (lists available packages). Frontend pricing sections use data-testid='buy-monthly-btn', 'buy-annual-btn' etc. PaymentSuccessPage handles 3 states: processing (checking payment), success (paid), error (no session_id or failed). The integration uses real Stripe test mode - checkout sessions redirect to checkout.stripe.com.
